cards.title: Camps and three enemies
cards.text: Rooms now hold camps guarding their shard. Darts, Spitters and Brutes join the mites.
cards.why: First part of stage 4, as you said go: camps first, then enemies a few at a time. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Version 0.6.0, on top of the fixes deck. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

Next in stage 4: statuses, the first boss at 5:00, breakable walls, then keys and the door.

parts.title: Camps
parts.text: Every room away from the start has a camp around its shard, resting (dim) until one sees you close or gets hit; then they all wake. Near rooms are easy, far ones hold brutes.

parts.title: Dart
parts.text: Magenta triangle. When it sees you it stops, shows its aim as a line, then charges straight until a wall. Hits hard. Dash sideways.

parts.title: Spitter
parts.text: Green diamond. Keeps its distance with you in sight and lobs slow orbs. A dash through an orb deletes it; your spawns block them.

parts.title: Brute
parts.text: Amber square, wider than you. Slow and tough, barely knocked back, shoves smaller enemies and you along.

parts.title: Who comes when
parts.text: Wave 2 brings darts, wave 3 spitters, from wave 4 a brute leads. Between waves the new ones start wandering in from 1:30.
